_description: Output field reference for message +search stdout JSON

fields.data.data: Array of message summary objects matching search; empty result is []
fields.data.data[].from: Sender object with name and email
fields.data.data[].from.name: Sender display name
fields.data.data[].is_read: Whether the message has been read
fields.data.data[].subject: Email subject
fields.data.data[].to[].name: Recipient display name
